runs.name: Northwest Natural Holding Company; NYSE NWN, SEC CIK 0001733998, Oregon, 10-K filer combined with Northwest Natural Gas Company; NW Natural gas distribution in Oregon and southwest Washington, SiEnergy gas distribution and transmission in Texas and NWN Water, SiEnergy and Pines Holdings bought 2025; the 10-K names no rival, Avista and Portland General Electric chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$48.99** (close 2026-10-16, `tools/run.py` live quote, aggregator, flagged). Shares 42,093,538 common on the cover of the 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 (0001733998-26-000127, as of 2026-07-28), `Screens/cover_shares.py` agreeing, against 42,093,292 issued and outstanding on that 10-Q's balance sheet, no treasury shares; no equity issue in the 8-Ks since; net debt $2,599.4M at 2026-06-30, operating leases left out, the NW Holdings Series F and G notes ($70M) and NW Natural first mortgage bonds ($120M, 8-K of 2026-09-03) issued after the balance-sheet date not added, said so. Sovereign **5.43%**, the US Treasury 30-year par yield of 2026-10-16 (issuing authority). Read from the 10-K for FY2025 (0001733998-26-000012), the 10-Ks for FY2024, FY2023 and FY2021, the 10-Q to 2026-06-30, the proxy filed 2026-04-17 (0001193125-26-161075) and the 8-Ks of 2026-06-05, 2026-07-31, 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-23; operating cash flow and capital spending for FY2025 cross-checked against the filed cash-flow statement. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7, stated in the run file with their items. Stock pay, missing from XBRL, taken from the filed equity statements. **Q1 IN**: a rate-regulated distributor read by its parts (rate base times allowed return; 9.5% on equity at 50% equity in Oregon, order of 2025-10-24, and in Washington, order of 2026-07-29; 9.8% in the Texas settlement; gas cost passed through, Oregon decoupled); the policy threat routed to Q2 as slow change, not to Q1 as fast change. **Q2 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: the NWN Gas Utility decides at 87.5% of 2021 to 2025 income from operations (SiEnergy 2.7%, water and other 9.8%); the castle stands today, an exclusive territory with no direct gas competitor and the return renewed in both States within the year, but meter growth has fallen from 1.5% (2020, 2021) to 0.3% (twelve months to 2026-06-30) with commercial and industrial meters falling, the OPUC ordered the line-extension allowance phased out and wrote $13.7M out of rate base, Washington's codes restrict gas in new buildings, Oregon's climate program requires a 50% cut by 2035 and its rules are on appeal, and the company's own filings say it cannot predict the outcome; not shown filling in (no refusal of return or recovery at scale), so not OUT; the forecast is of two States' legislatures, commissions and courts, so NATURE, not WORK. Ordinary regulator-set return carried as a second best, not deciding. No research pass (NATURE). After the stop, not weighed: capital spending 2.6 to 2.9 times depreciation; owner cash after all spending negative in four of five years; debt from $834M to $2,605M and goodwill from $0 to $371M over 2017 to 2025, equity doubled mostly by share issuance, retained earnings up $134M; market value up $229M for $729M kept or raised; holding-company equity 36.2% of capital against 49.4% at the utility; the Gasco uplands cleanup recorded at $284M, the low end of $284M to $950M; the proxy features an adjusted EPS excluding the 2024 disallowance (the integrity fact in the box line); no expense recognized at 2025-12-31 for the 2024-2026 performance shares and most of the 2025-2027, so recorded stock pay omits most of them, and some performance shares measured on cumulative EBITDA.COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE (the operator's reporting figures): owner cash 2021 to 2025 all-equity -$103.8M a year after all spending, $128.6M maintenance-only by the depreciation proxy, $76.1M equity-only; serial-acquirer specific applied (SiEnergy and Pines, $471.0M), the organic pair central; growth spending above depreciation credited at the authorized return, 6.49% after tax, as a CONVENTION of the run reconciling (e) and (f). Value range **-$5.49 to $2.64 a share** all-equity at the sovereign; no case reaches the floor, the most generous stream 4.33% on enterprise value (5.67% on equity); fair price **-$37.16 all-equity, not positive**, $17.65 equity-only; no alert (the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN). Competitors: the 10-K names none; Avista and Portland General Electric chosen as a CONVENTION of the run; return on equity 2018 to 2025 NWN 5.9% to 8.8%, Avista 6.5% to 10.6%, Portland General 5.9% to 9.2%. Contamination declared by the analyst: a `Test Runs/` listing showing the HOKCY, MDU, NJR and XNGSY run names of the day, the NJR fold's commit subject in the session context, the memory index lines; none used. **Write-early defect declared by the analyst**: the Step 0 and Q1 commit carried two stripped 10-K excerpts (116KB and 146KB) into the tracked tree; the Q2 commit moved them to the ignored cache, history kept at 46de7f08; no tracked research file over 200 KB at the fold. Commits 98520d0f (template), 46de7f08 (Step 0 and Q1), 5a25d725 (Q2), 721bb27e (the close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `idcheck.py` 41 ids, 22 quoted fragments, 0 problems; the dispatcher's `scripts/check_run_ids.py` 41 ids, no E-ids, 20 quoted fragments beside an id, 0 slips; **no citation slip**. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): which question owns a slow, political threat to a regulated franchise, Q1's ten-year fix or Q2's castle; the regulated-return exception when the grantor of the territory is also the threat; Q7 (e) against (f) for a utility whose spending buys rate base, reconciled here by a confessed convention; whether a filed integrated-resource-plan scenario set counts as a forecast written down under NATURE's test. Could not get: the company's own maintenance and growth split of spending, earnings guidance (press releases not read), Portland General's net income except through its comprehensive-income tag.
runs.narr: TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q2 (Northwest Natural Holding, NYSE NWN, Oregon and southwest Washington gas distribution with SiEnergy in Texas and NWN Water; Q1 IN, a regulated distributor at 9.5% on equity in both States; Q2: the gas utility decides at 87.5%, its exclusive territory stands today, but meter growth near zero, the line-extension allowance phased out, Washington's building codes and Oregon's climate program under appeal make its standing ten to twenty years out a forecast of state policy the company says it cannot predict; integrity facts recorded, not judged (an adjusted EPS excluding a disallowance). After the stop: spending 2.6 to 2.9 times depreciation, owner cash negative after all spending four years in five, $229M of market value for $729M kept or raised. COMPUTATION, not a clearance: value range -$5.49 to $2.64 a share at the 5.43% Treasury rate against $48.99; fair -$37.16 all-equity, not positive, $17.65 equity-only; no alert. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: Q1 or Q2 for a political threat, the grantor as the threat, Q7 (e) against (f) for rate base, scenario plans under NATURE.)
